_comment: Luke's fitness plan. Repeating 7-day training cycle (Day 1 = Monday). Generated by coach specialists via generate_plan.py. Edit individual sessions directly or re-run generate_plan.py to regenerate.

cycle_days.warm_up: 5 min dynamic: leg swings, hip circles, cat-cow, bird-dog.
cycle_days.short_version: Back Squat 1x6-8, RDL 1x8-10, Incline DB Press 1x8-10, Bent-Over Row 1x8-10. Skip Pallof Press.
cycle_days.purpose: Build lower body strength and support running economy with squat and hinge patterns.

cycle_days.warm_up: 10 min dynamic: leg swings (front/back + lateral) x10 each, hip circles x10, walking knee hugs x10m, walking lunges x10m, calf raises x15.
cycle_days.extras: Pre-squash (5 min): 10 thoracic rotations/side, lateral band walks x15/side. Post-squash (10 min): thoracic foam roll, standing adductor stretch.
cycle_days.short_version: Drop run to 20-30 min walk or skip. Prioritise squash.
cycle_days.purpose: Active recovery and maintain aerobic base without adding fatigue before squash.

cycle_days.session_type: Full Body Strength - Push Focus (Bench Priority)
cycle_days.warm_up: 5 min dynamic: arm circles, band pull-aparts, cat-cow, bird-dog.
cycle_days.short_version: Bench Press 1x6-8, OHP 1x6-8, RDL 1x10-12, Pull-ups 1x6-8. Skip Side Plank.
cycle_days.purpose: Maintain upper body strength with a focus on bench press, support overall athleticism.

cycle_days.session_type: Quality Run - Easy with Optional Tempo Segment
cycle_days.warm_up: 10 min dynamic: leg swings (front/back + lateral) x10 each, hip circles x10, walking knee hugs x10m, walking lunges x10m, calf raises x15.

run_details.pace: 10 min Easy (5:35-6:00/km, HR <150), then 40 min General Aerobic (5:25-5:45/km, HR 150-160). Optional 3-4 x 5 min at controlled tempo effort (comfortably hard, by feel) embedded, 10 min Easy cool-down.
run_details.effort: Controlled quality, focus on hitting MP segments precisely.

cycle_days.short_version: Drop to 45 min Easy run (5:35-6:00/km, HR <150). Skip MP segments.
cycle_days.purpose: Build specific endurance and efficiency with controlled tempo work, judged by effort rather than a target race pace.

cycle_days.warm_up: 5 min dynamic: hip hinges, glute bridges, band pull-aparts, bird-dog.
cycle_days.short_version: RDL 1x6-8, Front Squat 1x8-10, DB Bench Press 1x8-10, Seated Cable Row 1x8-10. Skip Woodchoppers.
cycle_days.purpose: Develop posterior chain strength and core stability, crucial for running power and injury prevention.

cycle_days.details: Full 40 min mobility session: deep squat hold 2 min, pigeon pose 90s/side, thread-the-needle 10/side, side lunge stretch 60s/side, ankle dorsiflexion mobilisation 2 min, supine hip flexor stretch 90s/side. Optional: 10 min foam roll (quads, IT band, upper back).
cycle_days.short_version: 20 min mobility (standard post-run template). Focus on hip flexors, calves, hamstrings.
cycle_days.purpose: Promote recovery, improve flexibility, and address specific mobility restrictions to prevent injury.

cycle_days.warm_up: 10 min dynamic: leg swings (front/back + lateral) x10 each, hip circles x10, walking knee hugs x10m, walking lunges x10m, calf raises x15.

run_details.effort: General aerobic, conversational but sustained. Focus on consistent HR.

cycle_days.short_version: Drop to 60 min General Aerobic run (5:25-5:45/km, HR 150-160).
cycle_days.purpose: Build aerobic endurance and time on feet, crucial for marathon performance.

hard_rules: No time goal for San Sebastian - run it as a controlled effort.
Easy means easy — HR <150 on easy runs.
Sleep is the override: <6h = drop to a walk or skip.
